title: A Young Artist from Home
text:
This month's magazine has a story about a young artist named Ali. Ali paints pictures of birds and trees in his small room. He started painting last year, when his grandmother gave him a set of paints.

Ali also sells his paintings at the weekend market. Many people like his bright colours and buy them for their homes. He says he wants to open his own art school one day.

questions.text: Who is the artist in the magazine story?
Where does Ali sell his paintings?
What can the reader most likely conclude about Ali?
options: He loves art and wants to continue
He wants to stop painting soon

questions.text: What is the most likely reason Ali sells his art at a market instead of a shop?
options: He wants to meet people and show his work
The shops are closed every day
He does not have any paintings
The market is free and quiet

vocabulary.definition: a person who creates paintings, drawings or other art
a place outside where people buy and sell things, often on certain days
strong and full of light or colour

paragraph_translations: Bu ayki dergide genç bir sanatçı olan Ali hakkında bir hikaye var. Ali, küçük odasında kuşların ve ağaçların resimlerini yapıyor. Geçen yıl, büyükannesi ona bir takım boya verdiğinde resim yapmaya başladı.
Ali ayrıca tablolarını hafta sonu pazarında satıyor. Birçok insan onun parlak renklerini seviyor ve evleri için satın alıyor. Bir gün kendi sanat okulunu açmak istediğini söylüyor.
